memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Migraine: chronic, 4-5 days/month, using sumatriptan SOS, prophylaxis propranolol 40 mg OD, topiramate 25 mg HS, naproxen SOS. Stable.
Depression: PHQ-9 8, on sertraline 50 mg OD, escitalopram 10 mg OD, mirtazapine 15 mg HS, reports improved mood, mild insomnia.
Plan: Continue current meds. Check weight, waist (92 cm, >90 cm male cut‑off). Advise balanced diet: breakfast - whole grain toast with avocado; lunch - mixed veg salad with grilled fish; dinner - lentil soup with brown rice. Due: HbA1c 2025-07-05.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Neurological examination: cranial nerves II-XII intact, no focal weakness, normal gait, no pronator drift. Migraine-related tenderness absent over temples. No meningism.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: CT head (non‑contrast): no acute hemorrhage, infarct or mass lesion. Ventricular size normal. No chronic ischemic changes.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Migraine has been about 4 days per month, sumatriptan helps within 2 hours. Mood better, sleeping ~6 hours, occasional early waking.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Migraine: frequency reduced to 2‑3 days/month, sumatriptan used 2 times last month. Propranolol 40 mg OD tolerated, topiramate 25 mg HS causing mild paresthesia; consider taper.
Depression: PHQ-9 5, reports better sleep, energy improved. Sertraline 50 mg OD, escitalopram 10 mg OD, mirtazapine 15 mg HS continued.
Plan: Taper topiramate by 12.5 mg HS weekly off over 2 weeks, then stop. Increase propranolol to 60 mg OD for better prophylaxis. Add vitamin D 1000 IU OD (not recorded elsewhere). Weight 78 kg, waist 90 cm (at cut‑off). Diet advice: breakfast - oatmeal with nuts; lunch - quinoa bowl with chickpeas; dinner - grilled chicken with steamed veg. Due: HbA1c 2025-10-12.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Migraine: now 1‑2 days/month, sumatriptan used once. Propranolol 60 mg OD well tolerated, no topiramate.
Depression: PHQ-9 4, reports good mood, sleep 7 hrs. Meds unchanged.
Pre‑diabetes: HbA1c 6.2%. Plan: lifestyle reinforcement – reduce refined sugars, increase fiber, aim 150 min/week brisk walk. Metformin not started yet.
Weight 77 kg, waist 88 cm (<90). Diet: breakfast - multigrain toast with egg white; lunch - mixed veg dal with brown rice; dinner - fish curry with salad.
Due: HbA1c 2026-01-22; lipid repeat annually.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Refer to Neurology for review of migraine prophylaxis despite propranolol 60 mg OD, patient requests alternative options. Include recent headache diary and medication list.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Neurology letter: Patient examined, migraine episodic, well controlled on propranolol 60 mg OD. Suggest adding amitriptyline 10 mg HS if needed, but current regimen acceptable. Return to primary care for routine follow‑up.
